scope: isolated local CVG/Qdrant/Redis plus Professor/Locker/frontend verification

commands.cvg_tests: PYTHONPATH=src QDRANT_HOST=127.0.0.1 QDRANT_PORT=6337 QDRANT_COLLECTION=rag_phase0 OPENAI_API_KEY='' RERANKING_ENABLED=false ../.runtime/venvs/cvg/bin/python -m pytest -q
commands.cvg_e2e: PYTHONPATH='cvg-master-rag-v2/src' QDRANT_HOST=127.0.0.1 QDRANT_PORT=6337 QDRANT_COLLECTION=rag_phase0 OPENAI_API_KEY='' RERANKING_ENABLED=false .runtime/venvs/cvg/bin/python scripts/phase05/phase05_e2e.py --mode full

A_representative_ingestion.observation: TXT document parsed, persisted, and indexed in the isolated workspace.

B_parsing_and_chunks.observation: One deterministic source produced one persisted chunk with canonical provenance.

C_embeddings_offline.observation: The embedding seam works with a deterministic 1536-dimensional test double; live provider quality was not run.

D_persistence_and_vector_index.observation: Canonical rag_phase0 named dense/sparse point was available after upsert.

E_known_query_retrieval.observation: Scoped query returned one result from the authorized collection.

F_grounded_answer.observation: Grounding and citation plumbing passed with a deterministic answer generator; live LLM quality was not run.

G_provenance.observation: Search and citation exposed collection_id and checksum for the retrieved chunk.

H_concurrent_requests.observation: Sixteen same-key lock attempts produced exactly one winner.

I_redis_lock.observation: Acquire, contention, wrong-owner unlock/renew, owner release, expiry, and malformed request checks passed.

J_restart_and_recovery.observation: The same Qdrant point and provenance were readable after an isolated service restart.

K_malformed_document.observation: Unsupported .exe input was rejected at the ingestion boundary.

L_provider_unavailable.observation: No OpenAI credential was present; deterministic plumbing ran, but live provider outage/quality behavior remains unverified.

M_vector_database_unavailable.observation: With isolated Qdrant stopped, CVG returned the persisted disk_fallback result; recovery was then verified after restart.

N_duplicate_ingestion.observation: Two identical ingestions produced the same document ID and one Qdrant point.

O_metrics_and_observability.observation: Structured CVG query/ingestion telemetry and Locker responses were observed; provider and production exporter behavior remain outside the local run.

limitations: The deterministic embedding and answer doubles prove plumbing, not provider quality.

The full legacy CVG suite still has data-dependent failures/errors because src/data/default/dataset.json and the historical Fluxpay corpus are absent from this clean checkout; no synthetic dataset was added.
No production deployment, external OpenWebUI, real OpenAI credential, or host Redis state was accessed.
